previous_goal_turn_classification: progress: confirmed renderer bug fixed, exact CPU reset/render verified, one native pretrained rollout completed, and bounded Clean wait reached its original deadline with no task execution.

resource_observation.method: nvidia-smi GPU inventory and compute PID queries

question: Does the currently defined shared-initial-noise contrast justify hours of native Clean execution as the next decisive security experiment?
root_decision: Not yet. Keep NanoWM as a matched pretrained/native-planner resource, but do not automatically resume the expensive panel solely because GPU availability changes. First define the concrete sampling contract, fixed permitted operation, falsifiable security claim and matched controls. This is not a requirement for a positive result before testing, nor a universal rejection of researcher-defined supply-chain threat models.
accepted_facts: NanoWM is a materially better matched carrier for stochastic dynamics forecasts consumed by native CEM than the previous TD-MPC2 Q-noise intervention.
Native CEM competence remains unmeasured. No resource deferral is a Clean failure.

For fixed candidates, appropriately shared full initialization tensors can preserve each complete forecast marginal while changing their joint law, subject to the stated separability and RNG assumptions.

An explicitly assumed sampler-supply-chain adversary is a legitimate research threat model; an independently writable online Goal branch or a discovered public deployment exploit is not required for every study.
Existing CartPole local losses remain valid within their recorded scope. Strong-controller and transfer counterevidence remain part of any future assessment.
why_current_next_step_was_incomplete: The current operation is a predetermined independent-versus-common-noise comparison. A performance difference alone does not distinguish an adversarial violation from an ordinary variance/optimization tradeoff.

The earlier targeted finite-bank rank-coupling operation and the new unconditioned shared-noise operation are different constructions. Success of the new Clean carrier would not by itself reproduce or transfer the old attack.

Single-candidate forecast quality does not specify a unique cross-candidate joint law. Native implementation independence can be the declared contract, but it must be stated as an implementation/service assumption, not inferred as a universal physical-law requirement.

The proposed trusted-independent restore removes the assumed sampler permission. Its usefulness and cost must be evaluated honestly; it is not a certified remote-provider defense when the provider can ignore seeds.
Current read-only scope did not fix the security-specific contribution beyond known common-random-number effects. A novel systems contribution remains possible, not established.

requirements_before_resuming_this_line.requirement: Name the actual implementation or explicitly added service boundary whose allowed stochastic law is relied on by the agent. Identify access/visibility and what remains protected. Do not label all alternative couplings intrinsically incorrect.

Freeze one concrete allowed operation and its selection/tuning rule before observing heldout utility. If testing the simple shared-noise contrast, label it a sensitivity control; do not rename a negative outcome as an attack after seeing it.
State what outcome refutes the proposed security mechanism, including equality/improvement, failure under native strong planning, ordinary matched-variance explanations, and nonselective recovery.

Use the existing fixed task panel and native planner/model budget after resource and scientific readiness both pass. Evaluate the final elite mean through real environment execution. No extra clean tuning or task replacement.
